scope_note: Frank's current token is a project-specific bearer credential, not automatically an OAuth access token. RFC 6750 is useful because it defines the general HTTP Bearer scheme and explicitly notes Bearer can protect resources using tokens from any source. RFC 9700 sender-constraining/audience guidance is therefore a candidate hardening mechanism, not silently promoted OAuth architecture.
